message:
fix(standby): a Punch is not a stray; one owner's cleanup takes its own leases only (keepalive-r2 2 e r3, D1 R2)

Codex codex_ka_e_src_r2.md.

D1 (its tail_punch_probe: one Punch, no session ever -> strays 1, tail 1): Receive tells a Punch from the target
apart -- counted as punches, never a stray, no tail. strays are now the target's datagrams that are not standby /
HelloAck / Punch: an observation of what it still sends, not a count of video.

R2: the runner is one per process, the app's screens (owners) are not. ReleaseWhere(prefix) releases the leases of
one owner (its key prefix) and no other; ReleaseAll stays for the runner's end. An old screen's late cleanup reclaims
its own leases and leaves the new screen's (even of the same PC).

standby_lease_test 75/75 (x3). Mutants: a Punch counted as a stray, ReleaseWhere as ReleaseAll -- both FAIL.
